detail.title: Hysteresis vs. Memory in Autocatalytic Reaction Networks
detail.summary: Revised analysis using stoichiometric submatrix criteria and biochemical computation insights to distinguish true history-dependent memory states from transient persistence in chemical reaction networks.
detail.reason: Revising the autocatalytic memory notebook based on newly integrated stoichiometric matrix and statistical physics evidence.
